gloss: The Narrow Road to the Deep North (Bashō's travel diary)

definitions.gloss: The Narrow Road to the Deep North
definitions.explanation: A travel diary in prose and haiku by {松尾芭蕉|まつおばしょう}, recording his journey of about 2,400 km through northern Japan in 1689. Published in 1702, it is the most famous work of haikai literature.

examples.japanese: {奥|おく}の{細道|ほそみち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{芭蕉|ばしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紀行文|きこうぶん}→紀行文：22669_kikoubun⟧だ。
examples.english: The Narrow Road to the Deep North is Bashō's travel writing.

examples.japanese: {奥|おく}の{細道|ほそみち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冒頭|ぼうとう}→冒頭：11725_boutou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{暗唱|あんしょう}できる→暗唱する：26776_anshousuru⟧。
examples.english: I can recite the opening of The Narrow Road to the Deep North.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{奥|おく}の{細道|ほそみち}をたどって⟦{東北|とうほく}→東北：27542_touhoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧した。
examples.english: During summer vacation I traveled around Tōhoku following the route of The Narrow Road to the Deep North.

notes:
The title is also written おくのほそ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧. Many of Japan's best-known haiku come from it, and towns along the route have monuments marking where Bashō stopped.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{月日|つきひ}→月日：04063_tsukihi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百代|はくたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過客|かかく}にして: "The months and days are travelers of a hundred ages" — the opening line
- {夏草|なつくさ}や{兵|つわもの}どもが⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧: "Summer grasses — all that remains of warriors' dreams" (at {平泉|ひらいずみ})
- {閑|しず}かさや⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧にしみ{入|い}る{蝉|せみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: "Such stillness — the cicadas' cry soaks into the rocks" (at {立石寺|りっしゃくじ})

CULTURAL NOTE:
Following the route today, on foot or by car, is a popular literary pilgrimage.
